notes: OWNER RULE: every purchasable rank costs exactly ONE advancement point, with no escalating rank price and no expensive one-rank capstone. Every complete eligible non-Monk tree build has exactly 100 purchasable ranks and thus 100 total points.

OWNER RULE: the 100 points cap describes a fully mastered single character, not the total of mutually exclusive visible alternatives. Hunter is 62 common + one 8-point training style + one 30-point favored-prey specialty.

Reduced total mastery cost from legacy ~300-500 SP is the source of increased potency per point. Do NOT shrink rank counts while keeping purchase price if doing so would charge more than one point per rank.

Sea Dragon Abyssal Fortune is 50 one-point ranks for 50 total points. If owner wants fewer ranks within one named skill, distribute those 50 levels among distinct meaningful Luck skills after reviewing effects; do not charge 5 points for a rank.
Ten fully costed first-pass non-Monk trees: universal Core + Hunter, Gilded, Vampire, Werewolf, shared Lich, three Dragon Survival species, Bare Zerker.
Early native abilities, species states, Fury mechanics, Gilded base Fortune/Looting, and Hunter free specialty selections remain free and separate. Never relicense or reprice without owner review.
Core is universal and independent of Newbie/Normie/Path identity; it is not a fifth dragon path or additional class.
Costs for every possible Hunter specialty cannot be summed as a playable 100-point build; the 498-point visible alternative catalog is intentionally greater than 100.

specialized_budget_contract.profile_budget_formula: Hunter=62 common+8 one training style+30 one favored specialty
specialized_budget_contract.rule: Exactly 100 individually purchasable 1-point ranks per eligible character tree; alternative catalog can exceed 100 only because incompatible specializations cannot be simultaneously purchased.

rank_granularity_contract.mechanism: One rank = one point. To reduce rank counts in a given named skill while keeping 100 total points, provide more distinct meaningful skills rather than charging multi-point ranks.
rank_granularity_contract.sea_dragon_luck: Abyssal Fortune = 50 one-point ranks; prior 10 ranks × 5 points draft was invalid.
rank_granularity_contract.exceptions: None; all purchased ranks cost exactly one advancement point, including Core, Gilded, and capstones.
rank_granularity_contract.effect_goal: Do not duplicate historical 300-500-point power pacing. Full-power target and +effect per *point* must be normalized and verified against source providers.
